proof: context.fast hands one context question to a bounded read-only sub-run. It is offered retrieval tools only, and its authority is decided at dispatch: a name outside CONTEXT_SPECIALIST_TOOLS is refused before any tool runs. In a real run it asks for change.apply, is refused, changes nothing on disk, and returns a Context Pack whose entries carry path, revision, content hash, reason and sources. Its model calls are ContextCompile steps under the actor context-specialist and its tokens are recorded on the calling turn, so the task's economics include them.
audit: NOT-FOUND before this task: nothing could take a context question off the agent's own turn budget.
limitations: Synchronous inside the caller's tool call; bounded by turns and the pack budget, not by a clock; no memory between calls.
